checks.description: No personal or sensitive data appears in URL parameters, query strings, UTMs, or tracking payloads.
checks.rule: Scan every link, UTM set, and tracking call. Any email, phone, name, or personal identifier in a URL or tracking payload is a fail; the fix removes it.

checks.description: Data is collected and used with valid consent for the stated purpose.
checks.rule: Fail when consent is pre-checked, missing, or does not cover the purpose the data is used for.

checks.description: The send audience excludes already-paying, unsubscribed, and hard-bounced contacts, and the exclusion is applied not just described.
checks.rule: Fail when any of paying, unsubscribed, or hard-bounced contacts are not excluded from the send audience, or when suppression is named but not applied.

checks.description: When the asset touches Saudi user data, sending, or storage, the Saudi PDPL and data-residency open item is surfaced for the human gate.
checks.rule: Fail when Saudi user data is involved and the PDPL or data-residency open item is not surfaced. The item is flagged, never assumed resolved.

checks.description: Where collected data goes is disclosed to the user and stated in the package.
checks.rule: Fail when a data flow (receiving platform, pixel, CAPI, third party) is undisclosed to the user or absent from the package.

checks.description: Compliance-facing copy never states or implies certificates are accredited.
checks.rule: Flag any wording implying accreditation. Completion certificates are not accredited; any such claim is a fail.

checks.description: The asset collects only the data the stated purpose needs; every field, parameter, and tracked attribute maps to a stated purpose.
checks.rule: Required by Saudi PDPL and GDPR. Fail when data is collected without a purpose it serves; the fix removes the field or states the purpose. An unclear case is surfaced as an open item. The gate flags the gap, it does not resolve the minimization basis.

checks.description: A retention or deletion stance is present: how long the collected data is kept and the path by which it is deleted.
checks.rule: Required by Saudi PDPL and GDPR. Fail when no retention or deletion stance is stated; the fix adds it. An unconfirmed period is surfaced as an open item. The gate flags the gap, it does not set the retention period.

checks.description: The asset states how data-subject access and deletion requests are handled: the route a user takes to reach or delete their data.
checks.rule: Required by Saudi PDPL and GDPR. Fail when no access or deletion route is stated; the fix adds it. An unconfirmed process is surfaced as an open item. The gate flags the gap, it does not stand up the rights process.

checks.description: The check does not adopt a tool, wire a platform, or resolve the platform open item.
checks.rule: Fail when the asset assumes adoption of a tool not on the approved allowlist, or treats the platform or PDPL open item as resolved. Such items are flagged for build-vs-buy and Ahmed's approval.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail and open items attached.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every check passes; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check. Correctly surfaced open items do not fail the gate; an unsurfaced relevant open item does.
